values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com (Elkhead Reservoir State Park listing, Bears Ears Campground) or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days in any 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site, vehicles kept on the pads; check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

sites.source: cpwshop.com campsiteDetails for Bears Ears sites 001-016 (Maximum Vehicle Length 48-66; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on 010, 012, 014, 016) + campgroundDetails loop listing (Bears Ears Campground: 12 Basic + 2 Basic - ADA), read 2026-10-28

note: Non-electric loop on a point at the east end of the Elkhead Reservoir dam, ~6,400 ft; open ground with hardened gravel pads and shade shelters, water on the north and west. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop per-site pages: sites 16 -> 14 (001, 003, 005-016; basic, 48-66 ft, 4 pull-throughs); confirmed no hookups, no water, no dump in the park; season ~May-Sep -> May 1 - Nov 30 (CPW); added url/window 180/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees (2026-10-12 cpwshop, $28; CPW page agrees) left as is. Note: dropped the restated site count/hookups/season/booking and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakeview) vs operator tag: cpwshop tags 5 of the 14 Bears Ears sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (009, 010, 012, 014, 016 - the north/west rim) and the other 9 untagged. Below-the-dam check: the loop sits on the RESERVOIR side, on a point at the east end of the dam with the pool on its north and west; the spillway and the downstream channel are west and south of it, so this is not a below-the-dam campground. On Esri imagery (pool appears full) the rim site points are ~15-40 m from the waterline with only open ground between; the stored evidence put the pads ~40-70 m back on a bench above a bare slope. An operator lakefront claim contrary to our lakeview triggers the gate - re-audit lead for the rim sites; not changed.

Site count: CPW's camping page says '46 Campsites' and 'six ADA-accessible campsites' across the park's two campgrounds; cpwshop lists 14 (Bears Ears) + 30 (Pronghorn) = 44 with 2 + 4 = 6 ADA. Recorded the cpwshop 14.
Phone 970-276-2061 confirmed on the CPW park page (the page also lists 970-276-2063).
